groq:free.note: Free plan, per organization. Cached tokens don't count. One free account sustained only ~20 RPM on openai/gpt-oss-20b on 2026-10-19 (adaptive limits handle this). Groq also applies input/output tokens-per-minute limits (ITPM/OTPM) to 'some organizations' without publishing values; the qwen otpm below was observed on one free account on 2026-10-21 (429: 'output tokens per minute (OTPM): Limit 1000').

openrouter:free.note: Any model id ending in ':free'. 20 RPM per model; the daily cap is shared across all free models (group openrouter:free-daily).

cerebras:free.note: Free trial; activating it needs a verified payment method. TPM is the total-token limit; the 1M tokens/hour limit is not modelled.

gemini:free.note: Google publishes no numbers; real limits are shown per project in AI Studio. Limits are per project, not per key. RPD resets at midnight Pacific. Defaults from one free project on 2026-10-19: gemini-3.5-flash-lite accepted 22 requests in one minute and over 120 in a day without a daily 429; set your own from AI Studio.

mistral:free.note: Free mode limits are per model and shown only in Admin panel > API > Limits. Conservative defaults.

openrouter:free-daily.note: 50 requests per UTC day across all ':free' models with under 10 credits bought; 1,000 with 10 or more. Override with createQuotaPool({ groups }).
